verdict.rationale: Mixpanel's Retention report explicitly assesses user engagement over time, and properties/cohorts allow filtering and grouping of users for behavioral segmentation, directly matching the story. Documentation confirms retention analysis, cohort creation via properties, and query/export APIs that support slicing by cohort. Missing for 10: independent hands-on evidence of retention-by-cohort slicing in practice and no community corroboration specifically on retention feature usability.
